name: Prosper Health
one_liner: Online autism assessments and autism-informed therapy for adults, by video with licensed clinicians; takes several insurance plans.
best_for: Adults who think they may be autistic and want a formal assessment by video
Autistic adults looking for a therapist who specialises in autism
People with Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare and other listed plans in states Prosper serves
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need a full neuropsychological evaluation or a standalone ADHD assessment
People who can't do sessions on camera or live in a state Prosper doesn't serve
short_description: Telehealth autism assessments and therapy for adults. Self-pay is $950 for an assessment or $125 per therapy session; several insurers accepted.
long_description: Prosper Health is a US telehealth practice for autistic adults and adults who think they may be autistic. It offers autism assessments by video with licensed psychologists (autism only, or autism plus ADHD in some states) and ongoing one-to-one therapy with autism-informed clinicians. It bills insurance including Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford and UnitedHealthcare and sends a cost estimate after checking your coverage; self-pay is $950 for the full autism assessment (payable in three instalments), $1,250 for a combined autism and ADHD assessment, and $125 per therapy session. It works in a limited and changing list of states, and it says its assessment is not a full neuropsychological evaluation and may not suit complex cases. No published studies of Prosper's service were found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; $125/session self-pay therapy, $950 self-pay autism assessment
pricing.notes: Accepts Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford, UnitedHealthcare and others; sends a cost estimate within a business day. Self-pay assessment $950 (3 payments of $316.67); autism plus ADHD $1,250. No standalone ADHD assessments.

privacy.notes: A licensed practice that bills insurance, so your clinical records are covered by HIPAA. We could not read the website privacy policy, so whether site data is shared for ads is unknown. Session recordings, if you consent, are used for AI-drafted notes and deleted within 30 days.

faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Combined autism and ADHD assessment (some states)
Help with anxiety, burnout and daily life as an autistic adult

patient_summary: Prosper Health lets you get assessed for autism as an adult, or see a therapist who specialises in autism, all by video. You can use insurance in the states it serves, or pay $950 for an assessment or $125 per therapy session. You start by filling in a short form on its website.

availability.note: Adults only, by video, in a limited and changing list of US states; check the current state list on its site.
